name: ZoomMate
desc: Zoom's AI teammate for agents, workflows and search.
desc_zh: Zoom 的 AI 同事，涵盖智能体、工作流与搜索
solves: AI Companion summarizes meetings. ZoomMate acts on what happened in them — agents, workflows, search across the conversation record.
solves_zh: AI Companion 只总结会议。ZoomMate 会对会议里发生的事采取行动——智能体、工作流、跨对话记录的搜索。
best_for: You live in Zoom and want the assistant to act after the call, not just report on it.
best_for_zh: 你整天在 Zoom 里，想让助手在会后采取行动，而不只是汇报。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：https://zoom.com/en/ai-assistant/。来源：https://zoom.com/en/ai-assistant/ 2026-11-25：released 2026-01-01/month → 2026-06-01/day; source https://news.zoom.com/zoom-launches-zoommate。原值 2026 年 1 月无出处。Zoom 官方新闻（2026-06-01）：「Zoom launches ZoomMate: the first AI teammate built to turn conversations into completed work」，当天正式发布
